title: AI is making ‘safe careers’ a thing of the past. Indian parents are scrambling for answers
description: As AI reshapes entry-level jobs and geopolitical uncertainty clouds overseas education, Indian parents are questioning long-held beliefs about safe careers. From engineering and medicine to theatre, sports and the humanities, families are rethinking what children should study. Educators and psychologists say adaptability, continuous learning and genuine interest may matter more than certainty.

title: Seven AI sales tools that reduce administrative work in 2026
description: Sales teams lose hours each week to CRM updates, meeting notes, and follow-ups instead of selling. New AI tools in 2026 tackle these drains, with platforms like Zig and Reevo automating broad execution while Avoma and Fireflies focus on meeting documentation.

title: ChatGPT's Kazakh language push exposes the cultural limits of English-only AI
description: A joint project with OpenAI produced a Kazakh-language AI benchmark built from over 14 billion tokens, not English translations. The 500-question test evaluates cultural knowledge like proverbs and history that direct translation misses.

title: Danny Boyle Confirms Use Of AI In New Movie ‘Ink’
description: Danny Boyle has confirmed the use of AI in new movie Ink about the launch of The Sun newspaper. Speaking to Vanity Fair, Boyle said he had used around 30 seconds of generative AI in the making of his new movie, which opened the Venice Film Festival this week before going on to play Telluride.
